The **Booster+** benefit allows you to carry forward any unutilized Base Sum Insured for a maximum of 3 times the Base Sum Insured. 

Key details regarding this benefit include:
* **Proportional Reduction:** If you reduce your Base Sum Insured, the Booster+ Sum Insured will be reduced proportionately.
* **Enhancement:** When you increase your Base Sum Insured, the accumulated Booster+ Sum Insured continues to grow, up to the maximum limit (3, 5, or 10 times the Base Sum Insured, depending on your chosen plan).
* **Safeguard+ Protection:** If you have the optional Safeguard+ benefit, your Booster+ will not be impacted if your total claims in a policy year do not exceed **INR 1,00,000**.
* **Floater Plans:** If a floater plan is split into multiple policies, the Booster+ Sum Insured is carried forward to the new policies, provided the Base Sum Insured is not reduced.

Please refer to your Policy Schedule to confirm which specific deductible amount applies to your coverage.

The policy covers emergency road ambulance services up to **INR 1,500** per hospitalization.

Mental illness treatment is covered up to the **Sum Insured**, subject to a sub-limit for specific disorders. For the following conditions, coverage is limited to **10% of the Base Sum Insured or Rs. 50,000, whichever is lower**:

*   Severe Depression
*   Schizophrenia
*   Bipolar Disorder
*   Post-traumatic stress disorder
*   Generalized anxiety disorder

This sub-limit applies on a cumulative basis and includes any related pre-hospitalization and post-hospitalization medical expenses.
The sub-limit for robotic surgeries is **Rs. 2.5 Lac**.
Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to **90 days** immediately following your discharge from the hospital.

The waiting period for the Critical Illness Cover is **90 days** from the first policy commencement date. Additionally, any listed Critical Illness resulting from a pre-existing disease is subject to a waiting period of **36 months** of continuous coverage.

The free look period is **thirty days** from the date of receipt of the policy document. During this time, you may review the terms and conditions and opt to cancel the policy if you are not satisfied, provided no claim has been made.

If the Life Assured commits suicide within **12 months** from the date of commencement of risk (or within 12 months of a policy revival), the company will refund the higher of **80% of the total premiums paid** (if any) up to the date of death or the unexpired risk premium value, provided the policy is in force. 

Upon making this payment, the policy will terminate, and all rights, benefits, and interests will stand extinguished.
If you have chosen a monthly premium payment frequency, the grace period is **15 days** from the premium due date.
You have up to 5 years from the due date of the first unpaid premium to apply for the revival of a lapsed policy, provided this is done before the policy's date of termination or maturity.

A terminal illness is defined as a medical condition in which the Life Assured is not likely to live for more than 6 months. This condition must be diagnosed and confirmed by two independent Medical Practitioners specializing in the treatment of such illness and approved by the company.
